records failed pickup\n  -\u003e seller_cancelled    seller records cancellation reason\n```\n\nCompleted, rejected, failed, seller-cancelled, and unsold auctions cannot return to an active state.\n\n## Server-side auction closing\n\nAdded [auctionCloser.js](D:/Bharanii/projects/trialForCloud/server/src/services/auctionCloser.js).\n\nThe job:\n\n- Runs once when the server starts.\n- Runs every 30 seconds afterward.\n- Finds only active listings whose `closingAt` has passed.\n- Selects the highest valid bid.\n- Sets the provisional winner and winning bid.\n- Marks auctions without bids as unsold.\n- Uses a conditional update on `status: \"active\"` so repeated processing is idempotent.\n- Does not depend on the React countdown or an open browser.\n\nLate bids remain rejected directly by the bidding endpoint even if the scheduled closing job has not processed the auction yet.\n\n## Seller decision API\n\nAdded:\n\n```http\nGET /api/listings/decisions\n```\n\nReturns the authenticated sellerâ€™s auctions awaiting a decision.\n\n```http\nPOST /api/listings/:id/decision\n```\n\nRequest body:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"decision\": \"approve\"\n}\n```\n\nor:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"decision\": \"reject\"\n}\n```\n\nOnly the listing owner can make this decision.\n\nSeller decisions use a conditional update requiring `status: \"awaiting_decision\"`, preventing repeated or competing decision requests from overwriting an earlier result.\n\n## Sale and handover APIs\n\nAdded:\n\n```http\nGET /api/listings/my-sales\n```\n\nReturns relevant lifecycle records for authenticated sellers and confirmed winners.\n\n```http\nPOST /api/listings/:id/handover/confirm\n```\n\nEither the seller or confirmed buyer can confirm handover.\n\nThe sale becomes `completed` only after both confirmations are recorded.\n\n```http\nPOST /api/listings/:id/handover/fail\n```\n\nRequest body:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"reason\": \"Buyer did not arrive at the agreed campus location.\"\n}\n```\n\nOnly the seller or confirmed buyer can record failed pickup.\n\n```http\nPOST /api/listings/:id/seller-cancel\n```\n\nRequest body:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"reason\": \"Item was damaged before handover.\"\n}\n```\n\nOnly the seller can cancel a reserved sale, and the cancellation reason and timestamp are stored.\n\n## Privacy and authorization\n\n- Seller and buyer identities are derived from authentication.\n- Users cannot decide on another sellerâ€™s auction.\n- Users cannot confirm handover for unrelated listings.\n- Users cannot record failed pickup for unrelated listings.\n- Only sellers can approve, reject, or cancel their sale.\n- Winner and handover details are only returned to the seller or confirmed winner.\n- Public listing APIs do not expose private account information.\n\n## Frontend changes\n\nThe existing **My Auctions** page now provides:\n\n- Auctions awaiting seller decision\n- Approve price action\n- Reject action\n- Provisional winner display\n- Winning price display\n- Reservation status\n- Seller and buyer handover confirmation status\n- Confirm handover action\n- Failed pickup action\n- Seller cancellation action with reason prompt\n- Success and error messages\n- Loading state\n\nThe auction detail page now displays lifecycle information to authorized participants, including:\n\n- Provisional winner\n- Seller decision\n- Reservation status\n- Current sale state\n\n## Documentation\n\nUpdated [README.md](D:/Bharanii/projects/trialForCloud/README.md) with:\n\n- State transition documentation\n- Phase 5 endpoints\n- Scheduled closing behavior\n- Authorization rules\n- Handover and cancellation behavior\n\n## Validation performed\n\nPassed:\n\n```text\nnpm run lint\nnpm run build\n```\n\nBackend validation passed:\n\n```text\nnode --check server source files\nserver import smoke test\n```\n\nAlso passed:\n\n```text\ngit diff --check\n```\n\nLive MongoDB lifecycle integration tests were not run because the local MongoDB instance still requires replica-set configuration for the existing Phase 4 bidding transactions.\n\nPhase 5 is complete. No additional auction features were started.",
